sources.title: OneTrainer - All diffusion training, one place
sources.snippet: OneTrainer is a free, open-source desktop application that lets artists, researchers and AI enthusiasts train their own Stable Diffusion models without writing a single line of code. Unlike scattered notebook scripts and half-maintained forks, OneTrainer unifies LoRA training, Dreambooth, textual inversion and full fine-tuning into one workflow.

sources.title: OneTrainer - Learn AI
sources.snippet: OneTrainer supports an exceptionally broad range of diffusion model architectures, reflecting the diverse and rapidly evolving generative AI landscape. The Stable Diffusion family is comprehensively covered, including versions 1.5, 2.0, 2.1, 3.0, and 3.5, as well as the extended SDXL architecture.
